metadata.title: Education at a Glance 2025: Korea country note (tertiary education focus)

survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This OECD country note is descriptive and does not report an individual-level ILSA micro-data analysis with an explicit sampling/replicate-weighting scheme. The figures and indicators draw on multiple OECD data sources (including PIAAC for adult literacy and other Education at a Glance indicators), but the note does not specify student-level survey weights or replicate-weight procedures. Because no microdata estimation model is presented, there is no weight variable (e.g., W_FSTUWT/TOTWGT) to apply for re-analysis. For users who want to reproduce indicator estimates from the underlying OECD datasets, the appropriate weights and replicate procedures would need to be taken from the corresponding Education at a Glance indicator methodology and technical notes (linked in the document).

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: This document is a descriptive country note that reports indicator statistics (e.g., attainment shares, unemployment rates, literacy proficiency levels) rather than estimating cognitive achievement models using ILSA plausible values. Plausible values are typically used for student achievement scales in ILSA assessments (e.g., PISA/TIMSS/PIRLS), but this note does not present any PV-based modeling or PV-combining procedure. Missing-data handling is therefore not reported because no microdata estimation pipeline is described; the note instead summarizes already-produced OECD indicators.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: The note provides indicator-based comparisons for Korea using the latest available reference year(s) from Education at a Glance 2025. It does not define an analytic student-level subsample (e.g., grade restriction, task/module restriction, or complete-case rule) because it does not conduct an original micro-data analysis; it reports published OECD indicator results.

data.outcome_summary: This OECD Education at a Glance 2025 country note summarizes key characteristics of Korea’s education system using already-produced OECD indicators. It highlights intergenerational patterns in tertiary attainment, trends in unemployment by educational attainment, and literacy proficiency levels from the OECD Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC), including changes between PIAAC Cycle 1 (2014) and Cycle 2 (2023). The note also reports system-level indicators such as education spending by level, compulsory instruction time, class size, and tertiary admission selectivity. No student-level ILSA microdata analysis is conducted in the note, and there is no description of an ML modeling pipeline, plausible-value estimation, or replicate-weighting strategy. As a result, the document should be interpreted as descriptive evidence for policy discussion rather than as an inferential study with model-based performance metrics.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This is not an empirical ML paper and does not present an original analysis with a defined analytic sample, PV handling, missing-data strategy, or model performance metrics. The note is a descriptive synthesis of Education at a Glance 2025 indicators (including PIAAC-based literacy proficiency), so fields required for predictive modeling (e.g., main_findings, ML techniques, confounders) are intentionally absent. Sparse extraction is therefore due to the document’s reporting purpose (indicator overview) rather than an omission of methodological details for an ML study.
